description: Count the minimum path cover produced by LDFS+ followed by the Rightmost-Neighbor sweep on a bounded cocomparability graph.

source.title: LDFS-Based Certifying Algorithm for the Minimum Path Cover Problem on Cocomparability Graphs
source.operational_search_source: G. B. Mertzios and D. G. Corneil, A Simple Polynomial Algorithm for the Longest Path Problem on Cocomparability Graphs, SIAM Journal on Discrete Mathematics 26(3), 940-963 (2012), DOI 10.1137/100793529, Section 2 Algorithms 2 and 3.
source.corrigendum: J. Dusart, D. G. Corneil, and M. Habib, Corrigendum: LDFS-Based Certifying Algorithm for the Minimum Path Cover Problem on Cocomparability Graphs, SIAM Journal on Computing 50(3), 1148-1153 (2021), DOI 10.1137/20M1327835; algorithms unchanged.
source.reuse: Algorithm descriptions and theorem attribution only; contract, workload, oracles, and ports are clean-room.

input.adjacency_mask: Bit v in row u means undirected edge {u,v}; rows are symmetric with no diagonal or out-of-range bits.
input.order: Permutation of vertices from left to right; must be umbrella-free.
input.umbrella_free_condition: For every i<j<k in order, edge(order[i],order[k]) implies edge(order[i],order[j]) or edge(order[j],order[k]).

output.meaning: Number of outer RMN iterations, which is the number of paths in the minimum path cover.

algorithm_profile.primary: Run LDFS+ over all vertices: choose the unvisited vertex with lexicographically largest newest-first sequence of visit timestamps, breaking ties by rightmost position in the supplied order; prepend the current step to each unvisited neighbor label. Then run RMN on the resulting order: start each path at the rightmost unvisited vertex and repeatedly visit the current vertex's rightmost unvisited neighbor.
algorithm_profile.independent: For each vertex subset compute whether its induced graph has a Hamilton path by endpoint subset recurrence, then use an anchored subset partition recurrence to find the minimum number of pathable subsets covering all vertices.
algorithm_profile.tie_policy: Labels compare as integer sequences; a longer sequence is greater when the shorter is its prefix. Equal labels select the rightmost vertex under the supplied order. RMN uses the same rightmost rule for starts and neighbors.
algorithm_profile.connectivity_validation: Breadth-first reachability must include every vertex.
algorithm_profile.order_validation: The supplied order must satisfy the umbrella-free condition, which is a cocomparability ordering.

complexity.primary_time: O(n^3) with bounded label comparisons and neighbor scans

workspace.meaning: Fixed adjacency rows, supplied and computed orderings, bounded LDFS timestamp labels, and RMN visited state.
